e_Q65_matching.T1_kin (M5.21.14 \u00a7 1.3): -8 sum_i |Mdot3 v_i|^2 : non-positive, g-flat at leading order, the same coefficient for every spatial partner i
e_Q65_matching.reading: for Z > 0 and Y >= 0 the author's coefficient is non-negative (its minimum over Y is the free-record value Z (s_i^2 - s_j^2)^2 / (s_i^2 + s_j^2) >= 0) and its leading term Z g grows with g, while T1_kin is non-positive and g-flat: with a positive internal inertia the two forms part at the SIGN (the Lorentzian time row against a Euclidean internal pair). The only identification that reproduces a g-flat, partner-independent, negative leading term is Z = -z/g (a negative, 1/g-suppressed internal inertia): then C = -z + lambda z (3 z + Y) / ((z - Y) g) + O(1/g^2) for Y < z (a pole at Y = z), the first correction partner-dependent. Form level: 'a different object' unless the author's Z is allowed negative and O(1/g); the step where the forms part is the sign of Z
e_Q65_matching.fails_if: the series or the sign bound is wrong (sympy)
